about: Whole imports (CourseImporter.parse) with the standard 12-period schedule and an 18-week term. A sample has its text inline or a file in this folder (decoded with ImportedText.decode). courses: name|teacher|room|weekday|first-last period|first-last week parity. problems: line, then missingColumns <columns> / missingValue <column> / invalidValue <column> <text> / periodsOutOfRange <text> <periods per day>.
